Great speaking earlier. Per our model, list hosted API rates would imply ~ $6,500 / month at current usage. HealthCore is proposing a 30% concession (net effective ~ $4,550 / month) for a 12-month committed pilot plus a joint case study and a reference agreement.

I can approve up to 15% on my own for strategic trials; this request is for 30% ( >20%), so I need exec sign-off. Key points:
- Commitment: 12 months, auto-renew off
- Volume: starts ~2M tokens/month, expected 3x by month 6
- Deliverables: joint customer case study, Redwood logo in partner page, early feedback on latency/edge routing
- Risk: data residency question (HealthCore prefers EU data processing for product teams) — they said US-only for now but may ask later

I’m attaching usage export and a draft SOW. Requesting Ben and Mina to greenlight economics and Karthik to confirm deal desk routing/terms.

Thanks,

Ran the back-of-envelope and a quick margin model. Key takeaways:
- If we get the 12mo commitment and a minimum spend equal to 6 months of expected usage, net margin is ~18% for the 12mo pilot (acceptable for a reference-driven play).
- Risk: if they churn after 3 months despite the 12mo term, collection and enforcement on minimum spend is critical. We should require an upfront 2-month non-refundable retainer to mitigate.
- We need legal to approve the case study and reference language; marketing will want an editorial review before publishing.

I’m OK recommending exec approval subject to the retainer and the 6-month minimum-spend clause.
